name: Trellis
author: Erin Carter
description: An orthogonal grid of glowing conduits with a bright pad lit at every junction, like a printed circuit board carrying charge along its traces. The current runs the nearer axis of each crossing so the whole lattice reads as one routed network over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Size of each grid cell in CSS pixels - a fine dense circuit at the minimum, broad open routing at the maximum.

params.label: Trace weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing trace in CSS pixels, from a hairline route to a fat neon bus.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge running the traces; 0 freezes the light at the pads, high sends it coursing across the board.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around traces and pads; low is a crisp drawn board, high a luminous bloom.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Turns the whole board; 0 is an upright square grid, 45 a diamond lattice, anything between a tilted circuit.

params.label: Pad size
params.effect: Radius of the lit junction pads where traces cross, from tiny vias to fat solder nodes that bloom at every crossing.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls the colour mix, the per-trace depth, and the trace scatter into a fresh arrangement of the board.

params.label: Colour blend
params.effect: How the trace colours join across cells; 0 hard-switches the hue at every cell edge a trace crosses, 1 blends them into one smooth continuous colour field.

params.label: Scatter
params.effect: Nudges each trace off the regular grid; 0 is a perfect lattice, higher scatters the rows and columns into an irregular hand-routed board with junctions still lit at every crossing.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: Spreads the traces across depth; 0 holds them all on one plane, higher makes some traces read as near (bright and fat) and others far (dim and thin) for a layered board.
